_readme: The template of settings.json (git-ignored). scripts/setup_windows.ps1 (scripts/setup_core.py) creates settings.json from it, pointed at the Python environments it makes in envs\ (venvs: envs\<name>\Scripts\python.exe), with speech_device and the embedder on the CPU when there is no NVIDIA GPU and vision on when the GPU has 16 GB or more; it never changes an existing settings.json. Interpreter paths may be relative to this folder; absolute paths to other environments (or a conda environment's envs\<name>\python.exe) work too. brain = Python 3.11 + brain/requirements.txt; speech = Python 3.11 + CUDA torch + speech/requirements.txt (also runs the Discord/Telegram service); embedder = its own environment with CUDA torch + brain/requirements-embedder.txt (BAAI/bge-m3, about 2.3 GB in the Hugging Face cache; the setup downloads it). The vision block gives her eyes: a small local VLM (vision/requirements.txt) that describes your camera feed; enabled:false runs without it.

vision._models: qwen3-vl-2b (~4.3 GB VRAM, zh/en/ja, default) | qwen3-vl-4b (~9 GB, sharper but slow on some stacks) | qwen2.5-vl-3b (~7.6 GB) | smolvlm2-2.2b (~5 GB, EN) | smolvlm2-500m (~1.2 GB, tiny EN)

services._readme: Optional. Programs the launcher starts in its one console (and stops with Ctrl+C). Paths relative to this folder. health = URL answering when up, or port = TCP port opening when up; after = start once that service is up. A service already running is used as is. The smart-home services (mqtt, zigbee2mqtt) start only after the IoT safety statement (docs/IOT_DISCLAIMER.md) was accepted on the Tools page.

tts._readme: The OpenAmika voice server (vendor/tts-engine, a MekaHime build of GPT-SoVITS) with Amika's voice. scripts/setup_tts.py installs both (with her Live2D model); until then the launcher's TTS row says to run it and she answers in text only. Keep --character in step with tts_character.
